يعتزما (form VIII)
# يَعْتَزِمَا (yaʕtazimā) /jaʕ.ta.zi.maː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# يُعْتَزَمَا (yuʕtazamā) /juʕ.ta.za.maː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
